patterns.note: A consistent dark mode theme is applied across all sections, utilizing a deep charcoal background with contrasting light text and UI elements.
Large, bold sans-serif headings introduce each major section, providing strong visual hierarchy, while body text is smaller and lighter for readability.
The primary palette is dominated by dark grays and white, with vibrant, yet subtle, accent colors (blue, orange, pink) used sparingly within embedded product UI screenshots to highlight features.
Major content blocks, particularly the embedded product UI screenshots and their accompanying text, reveal with a subtle fade-in and slide-up animation as they scroll into the viewport.
Each feature section follows a consistent two-column layout, pairing a prominent left-aligned heading and descriptive text with a detailed product UI screenshot on the right.

technique_notes: The site employs a dark theme with high contrast, achieved by using a very dark background color and light text colors for optimal readability.
Content sections are structured with a prominent left-aligned heading and a right-aligned visual element, often an embedded product UI, creating a clear visual hierarchy.

Elements, particularly the product UI screenshots and descriptive text blocks, are revealed using a staggered fade-in and subtle vertical slide-up animation as they enter the viewport, likely triggered by scroll events using CSS keyframes.

design_tokens.type_scale: Large, bold sans-serif headings (~3-4x body text) with a generous line height, paired with smaller, legible body text.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle rounding on interactive elements and within embedded UI, but sharp edges for main layout blocks.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced to airy, with generous vertical spacing between major sections and ample negative space around content blocks.

standout: The site's distinctive use of a deep, consistent dark mode combined with embedded, interactive-looking product UI screenshots creates a highly immersive and product-centric experience. The subtle, staggered scroll-triggered animations for these UI elements make the product feel dynamic and alive, effectively showcasing its capabilities within the marketing page itself.
